invariants: Observe explicit existing base/target commit references without checkout, fetch, source/index write, upstream pin change or task state transition; require the unchanged clean pinned Source checkout.
NUL-delimited Git name-status preserves Unicode/whitespace paths and both rename/copy owners; invalid or incomplete streams fail closed.

All pinned tracked manifests, exact bytes, names, nearest owners and declared dependencies/peer/optional/dev edges are checked against actual Source before reporting advisory direct/transitive reverse impacts and independent non-package surfaces.
Source HEAD/status and inventory bytes must remain unchanged across observation; optional output is exclusive and cannot write source, Git or migration state.

Meaningful tests include the actual rc.1 source parent-to-pin exercise (252 manifest changes, 252 direct owners and one transitive owner), alpha-to-rc.1 padded renames, real temporary Git rename/deletion/addition history and invalid/ref-injection/drift/output refusals. Complete tests must pass before bounded integration.
identity: Full base/target commit IDs, unchanged pinned checkout and SHA256 of the exact manifest inventory identify an observation.
ownership: The caller chooses existing Git references and owns a new report file; the observer owns no migration states or runtime services.
ordering: Verify pin and manifest closure, resolve commits, parse immutable Git diff, map both paths and reverse declared dependencies, recheck source/inventory, then write an exclusive report.
errors: Dirty/wrong pin, changed/missing/duplicate manifest inventory, malformed stream, invalid references, mid-observation drift and protected/occupied output all refuse.
cancellation: No background watcher or scheduled side effect is installed; an interrupted invocation cannot claim parity or advance task state.
adaptation: Python3.8 standard library plus development Git; no new Portable runtime dependency.
open_questions: Advisory pinned-manifest impacts do not resolve arbitrary dynamic runtime edges or certify a future upstream migration; full D1 export/role coverage and D2 uncached/remote Actions remain separate.

rc1_review.scope: Current finite executable provider/consumer corpora, original-browser and extracted observations in the single full receipt. Historical alpha evidence remains historical; no inventory-wide parity, arbitrary ABI/history, paid-provider or Win7 certification.
